rooms.name: Apex Threshold
rooms.description: The second floor begins at a calm overlook beneath the final chamber.

rooms.name: Still Shrine
rooms.description: A shrine branch offers a deterministic event reward source.

rooms.name: Guardwalk
rooms.description: The direct ascent begins with a guard lane that refuses a soft opener.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Outer parapet with exposed edges and a fast first clash.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Immediate-threat arena that keeps the final floor's pacing sharp.

rooms.name: Warden Core
rooms.description: The apex opens into the final chamber where the Warden anchors the run's completion gate.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Singular heartline arena with no cover and total commitment.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Final boss map with a clean silhouette and one exposed decisive lane.

rooms.name: Mirror Causeway
rooms.description: The shrine route folds back into a mirrored bridge where the last patrol manifests.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Reflective lane suspended over the apex basin.
rooms.combat_map_summary: A branch payoff fight that translates shrine tempo into renewed pressure.

rooms.name: Crown Crucible
rooms.description: Both ascent routes lock into a final proving arena before the Warden chamber.
rooms.combat_map_theme: Compressed proving ring with no dead corners and a bright center.
rooms.combat_map_summary: Last standard combat map used to tighten resources before the end-run boss.
